name: pdf120
description: Chrome MV3 PDF viewer tuned for 120Hz scrolling: pdf.js rendering in workers via OffscreenCanvas, virtualized native scrolling, LRU bitmap cache.

scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f ../pdf120-v$npm_package_version.zip && zip -qr ../pdf120-v$npm_package_version.zip . -x '*.map'
